title: Cody Johnson - Human: The Double Album
coreRelationships: The man's profile and the guitar form a strong diagonal composition.
The dark cowboy hat contrasts sharply with the light sky and the man's face.
The warm tones of the man's jacket and guitar stand out against the cool, muted background.
The typography is positioned as a clear header, anchoring the top of the composition.
reuseFormula: Photograph a male subject in profile, wearing a cowboy hat and a textured brown jacket, holding an acoustic guitar. Position him to the left and lower-center against a soft, light, overcast sky. Overlay custom-designed, dark, all-caps sans-serif typography at the top center, featuring a wider font for the main name with a unique geometric 'O' character, separated by a dotted line from a condensed font for the album title.
